messages:
Maya (CS): Drafting a short customer-facing one-pager for phased prefill + renewal-risk play. Goal: minimize cold-start penalty during trial and give AMs a clear escalation path if customers show churn signals. Need quick pass.

Diego (CS): Nice. Can we include a tiny flow diagram? Also suggest a light/med/heavy priming matrix by expected concurrent sessions.

Maya (CS): Yes — will add a compact matrix. Proposal: 
- Light (trial, <1 qps): 3 prefills over 10m, prefix cache for top 3 intents
- Medium (paid-sm): 15 prefills over 30m, enable KV caching + sampling checks
- Heavy (paid-lg): 50 prefills over 60m, reserve 5% burst capacity with grace token active

Sasha (SRE): Operational notes: start with a 30ms warm batching window, then ramp to 6ms steady. Keep priming TTL short (default 5m) and increase to 1h after sustained traffic. Monitor: p50/p95/p99, kv hit%, and priming hit rate.

Diego (CS): For AM script, propose two lines: 1) "We ran a small warmup to improve latency for your demo", 2) "If you run into cost/noisy-outputs, we can dial back prefill or switch to a smaller model."

Noah (PM): Add a renewal-risk primitive: 'grace token' attached to tenant metadata. When used, it triggers a 14-day prioritized outreach window and reserves minimal compute during demos. Also capture a renewal_score (0-100) from AMs post demo.

Maya (CS): Feedback capture plan: 1) 24h micro-survey (3 quick checkboxes + optional text), 2) automated daily sample comparison on canonical prompts, 3) immediate AM alert if quality delta > 4% on critical prompts.

Sasha (SRE): Snippet for recommended batching config to paste in runbook: 
```
# recommended batching profile
batching.warm_window_ms = 30
batching.steady_window_ms = 6
batching.max_batch_tokens = 2048
```

Diego (CS): Also include a short troubleshooting section: 
- If p99 spikes: check model fallback triggers and cached-prefix eviction rates
- If kv hit% < 60%: validate prefix keys and sampling frequency
- If renewal tokens consumed too fast: check demo routing and reserved capacity settings

Maya (CS): I'll add a tiny JSON example for the AM to flip a grace token: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "cust_123",
  "grace_token": true,
  "grace_expires_at": "2024-11-12T18:30:00Z",
  "reserved_demo_percent": 5
}
```

Noah (PM): Include a rollback recipe: automatic model family downgrade + notify AM if latency > 2x baseline for > 2 minutes. Also document a fast-turn sample test to validate quality after rollback.

Diego (CS): Quick thought: put a short 'what to say' script for risky-renewal calls. Example: "We noticed X drop in success on Y prompts; small change Z usually fixes it. Want me to schedule a 15-minute fix walkthrough?"

Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll format this as a 1-page handout + a single Slack snippet for AMs to paste. Plan to publish under #customer-success/docs tomorrow after one more review.

onboard-bot: Created doc 'phased-prefill-and-grace-token-playbook' in /docs — please review.

Sasha (SRE): I'll run a sandbox run of the prefills tonight against a staging tenant and post results here.

Diego (CS): Thumbs up. If staging looks good, we'll ship to the onboarding kit. :rocket:
